lines.text: Drizzle 89.3. It's raining. More at noon.
Ferry update: two hours. Here's a song.
Bigfoot called in. He declined to comment.
Espresso line's out to the highway.

meta.notes: The DJ's chatter for Drizzle 89.3 FM (run W-P, maintainer 2026-10-01b: unique regional flavor everywhere), named by the station's djBarkSet. Nothing plays DJ lines yet: the radio needs a between-tracks slot that reads this set, an audio-lane follow-up. Until then the `tag:` speaker never matches a rider, so these lines never reach a race bubble. Unvoiced on purpose: a DJ voice is a new casting for tools/voices/cast.json, made when the radio can play it.
